title: Annexes
description: data/annexes.json -- the annex sources and their excerpts as the export writes them, read by lib/calc-engine.typ (show-extract, show-annexes, docs/domain/documents.md §3.3octodecies). Every excerpt resolved against its source's current version, each written as a one-page PDF cropped to its frame (data/annexes/<id>.pdf); every source's annex as the pages it carries (data/annexes/<id>-annex.pdf). Nothing is computed: an excerpt is a picture of another program's calculation, so there is deliberately no {vars, steps, checks} record here.

schema_version.description: -- 1.0, or 1.1 where the PDFs of the excerpts and the annexes are named from the Typst root (`/Appendix/Exports/E01.pdf`), written by a project laid out by folders (issue #64, D-19): an export written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

sources.description: Keyed by id, in file-name order -- the order the annexes are lettered A, B, C in.

pages.description: The source's page count; 0 where its PDF is missing.

bookmarks.description: How many bookmarks it carries; 0 for a PDF printed through a PDF printer.

excerpts.description: The ids of its excerpts, sorted.

annex.description: The pages the annexes carry, or null where they carry none.

file.description: Relative to data/: annexes/<id>-annex.pdf, its pages in the order of `pages`.

sizes.description: Each page's width and height in points, in the order of `pages`.

resolved.description: false where the excerpt could not be found in its source's current version -- the report then refuses it, with `reason`.

reason.description: Why it is not resolved, in English; "" where it is.

page.description: The source's page it is taken from.

title.description: The title of the bookmark it is anchored on, as the source writes it; "" for a page anchor.

file.description: Relative to data/: the one-page PDF cropped to the frame; "" where unresolved.

size.description: The frame's width and height in points.

rect.description: The frame as [x, y, w, h] below and right of the page's top-left corner, in points -- where the annex page draws it.
